scientific_hypothesis: The zero-candidate failure is caused by constructing remaining-query sets through seeded representative sampling rather than directly from label-free query partition signatures. A deterministic partition-signature generator can improve structural coverage without changing solver thresholds or consulting labels, objectives, costs, dataset identity, or observed solver performance.

single_allowed_algorithmic_change.name: partition_signature_remaining_generator
single_allowed_algorithmic_change.description: For each allowed set, compute each compiled query's deterministic truth signature over allowed rows, group queries by identical signatures, and construct remaining-query masks from complete signature classes plus deterministic class representatives. Candidate order is the SHA-256 structural rank of task shape and masks.

implementation_order: add synthetic unit tests for determinism, label independence, complete-class construction, and duplicate-signature handling
prove unchanged state digests for tasks where the v0.83 selector already contributes
only after those checks pass, create a separate opened-data development workflow
negative_result_policy: Every failed preflight, coverage gate, correctness gate, or performance threshold is retained as a permanent negative result. No threshold may be weakened after inspecting results.
claim_boundary: This is a preregistered opened-data development repair. A successful result would not constitute fresh external validation, independent reproduction, a world-class result, or a general-AI breakthrough.
